rejects.problem: The English alternative "There are lots of fruit" is grammatically incorrect in standard English; "fruit" as a collective mass noun takes a singular verb ("There is lots of fruit").
rejects.fix: Change the third English alternative to "There is lots of fruit." or remove it.
